acceptanceCriteria: The repository-bound MCP knowledge_query response reports the same derived-projection write boundary and never presents the projection as governance authority.
Attach creates the repository-local .ai/knowledge directory idempotently without inventing records or governance decisions.

Knowledge query and query --v2 materialize deterministic projections bound to archive source data and report their write boundary; missing, stale, or invalid projections are rebuilt only through the explicit query/refresh path.
Install, upgrade, profile/configuration, and correction/reconciliation documentation clearly distinguishes Runtime-global behavior from repository-local Knowledge and preserves repository isolation.
Current repository and a fresh attached adopter pass regression checks proving authoritative archive/evidence/decision records remain unchanged by Knowledge projection.
Three-language documentation and static tests no longer claim that a query never writes .ai when the Runtime materializes a derived index.
The resulting behavior is ready for the next immutable release and its post-release adopter acceptance.
goal: 让 Knowledge 的目录、索引、来源 digest 与刷新时机可验证且不会被误认为第二事实源；为本批次发布提供稳定的仓库/对象继承基线。
intent: 明确并修正 Knowledge 派生投影在 Runtime 安装、仓库 attach、配置升级与纠正流程中的边界，并确保当前工程与对象工程获得一致、可审计的知识物化行为。
outOfScope: Runtime binary installation without an explicit repository context
Business code or global Agent/MCP configuration in adopter repositories
Release metadata/public publication (handled by the following release Work Item)

scenarioCoverage.expected: Attach creates a repository-local knowledge directory idempotently without creating records or decisions.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run attach twice on a fresh repository and compare the scaffold and authoritative records.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The legacy knowledge query deterministically materializes an index and records from archived Work Items.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the CLI query against an archived fixture and verify source digest, output, and generated paths.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The v2 knowledge query materializes a repository-bound index without changing authoritative governance bytes.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run query --v2 and compare Contract, evidence, archive, and decision digests before and after.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A missing, stale, or malformed derived projection is rebuilt through the explicit query path and never grants authority.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Tamper or remove the derived index, change an archived source, and verify deterministic rebuild behavior.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A fresh attached adopter receives repository-local Knowledge behavior and cannot read or write the Cockpit repository projection.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the installed Runtime with explicit repository contexts and compare knowledge roots and identities.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The repository-bound MCP knowledge query materializes only repository-local derived data and reports its boundary.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Call knowledge_query through the repository-bound MCP handler and assert projection metadata and repository isolation.
